scope: Extend public mobile Inspector/Canvas parity to responsive minWidth and maxWidth constraints, including inheritance and reset; preserve the existing mobile height/minHeight fix.

finding.source: The mobile public fallback enforced min-width:0!important and max-width:100%!important on ordinary nodes. The renderer already emitted the resolved responsive inline minWidth/maxWidth declarations, but the fallback declarations won the cascade.
finding.impact: Mobile minWidth/maxWidth Inspector overrides and inherited desktop/tablet values could render differently publicly than on Canvas after Publish or reset.
finding.related_prior_fix: 8ec0488ca35cc842d09c66af7fb3b00fedd70268 deployed mobile height and minHeight parity; this follow-up completes all four mobile min/max width/height constraints in the same fallback path.

implementation: The renderer emits --editor-mobile-min-width and --editor-mobile-max-width from the active viewport's CSS-validated responsive values.
Both the static visual-page.html and dynamically injected public fallback now use those variables, retaining 0/100% defaults when the Page Model has no value.
The public renderer asset cache key is 20261027-mobile-box-dimensions.

Extended the real Chromium lifecycle to cover all four mobile dimension constraints through inherited values, Inspector edits, draft Save/reload, separate Publish, desktop preservation, and mobile reset.
